a11y.logoLongPress: Press and hold to open admin options
a11y.countdownRunning: Recording in {{seconds}} seconds. Tap cancel to stop it.

availability.title: Availability
availability.newFromEmployee: The person wrote this and you hadn't seen it yet.
availability.emptyWeekly: Nobody has said anything that repeats every week yet.
availability.howTitle: Your team writes it from their phone
availability.howBody: Each person signs in to Krealo Shift with their account and, in “My availability”, taps Add: “I can't on Tuesdays”, “I have an appointment on the 15th” or a comment. It reaches you here with an orange dot and shows in the Schedule next to their shifts. You can also add it on their behalf.
availability.notePlaceholder: For example: I study on Tuesday mornings
availability.errorHours: Check the hours: the end has to be after the start.
availability.portalBody: Tell your store which days you can't work, or leave a comment. Whoever builds the schedule sees it.
availability.portalEmpty: You haven't said anything yet. If there's a day you can't work, add it here.

admin.nobodyRightNow: Nobody is clocked in right now
admin.nobodyRightNowHint: People working, on break, late or absent show up here.
admin.workingNowFailed: We couldn't load who's in right now
admin.workingNowFailedHint: The rest of today is up to date. Try again in a moment.

auth.setupKioskLink: Set up as a time clock
auth.employeeNoAccountNotice: Employees don't need an account: they clock in with their PIN on the store clock.
auth.signOutEverywhereHint: Signs you out on your phone and any other device where you signed in. It does not affect the store clocks: those use their own credential.
auth.signOutEverywhereConfirm: You'll be signed out of this app and every other device where you signed in. You'll need to sign in again on each one.
auth.demoHint: Demo mode: sign in with this button, no Google account needed.
auth.googleFailed: Could not sign in with Google. Please try again.
auth.emailHint: You get a link to sign in: no password and no Google account. It works with the email you were invited with, whether Outlook, Gmail or your company’s.
auth.emailSentBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it on this same device to sign in. If it hasn’t arrived in a couple of minutes, check your spam folder.
auth.emailCompleting: Signing you in with your link…
auth.emailConfirmTitle: Which email did the link go to?
auth.emailConfirmBody: You opened it on a different device from the one that asked for it. Type that email to confirm it’s yours.
auth.emailLinkUsed: This link was already used or has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.emailLinkWrongAddress: That isn’t the email the link was sent to.
auth.emailNotEnabled: Email sign-in isn’t turned on yet. Sign in with Google or tell your administrator.
auth.emailTooMany: Too many links were requested. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.emailFailed: Couldn’t send the link. Check the email and try again.
auth.googleUnavailableNative: Google sign-in is not set up for iPad yet. Let support know: the panel still works in a browser.

band.title: The day at a glance
band.hint: The light line is the shift; the solid one is what was actually clocked.
band.onTime: Clocked in on time and is on shift.
band.late: Clocked in later than their shift.
band.noShow: Had a shift and has not clocked in.
band.unscheduled: Clocked in without a scheduled shift.
band.empty: No shifts or clock-ins at this location today.

boot.noAccessTitle: Your account has no access yet
boot.noAccessBody: You signed in as {{email}}, and no company has an invitation or staff record for that email that could be activated.
boot.noAccessBodyNoEmail: You signed in, but your account has no access to any company.
boot.noAccessInvitedBody: You need to use the same email the invitation was sent to. If it is a different one, sign in with that.
boot.noAccessAskAdmin: If the email is right, ask whoever invited you to check it in Settings → “Who has access”, then try again.
boot.noAdminTitle: Your account can't open the panel
boot.noAdminBody: You signed in correctly, but your account is set up as an employee. The admin panel is for owners, admins and managers.
boot.noAdminClockInBody: Use the clock at your location: enter your 6-digit PIN and pick an action. You don't need an account or a password to clock in.

demo.banner: Demo mode: this data is made up and resets on reload. There is no real server.

errors.generic: We couldn't complete that. Try again.
errors.network: We couldn't connect. Your entry was saved on this device.
errors.duplicateEvent: There's already an entry recorded. We updated your status.
errors.invalidTransition: That action doesn't match your current status.
errors.kioskWrongLocation: This clock belongs to a different store.
errors.concurrentEdit: Someone else changed this. Reload it.
errors.deviceCredential: This device couldn't read its credential. Restart it; if it keeps happening, an administrator needs to set it up again.
errors.notConfigured: This app is not connected to its server yet. An administrator needs to configure it; retrying won't help.

home.allClearBody: Nobody is running late, nobody is missing, and there are no requests or entries to fix. Right now {{working}} are working and {{onBreak}} are on a break.

headline.late_one: person hasn't arrived for their shift
headline.late_other: people haven't arrived for their shifts

action.absent_one: Their shift ended with no clock-in at all, so it counts as an absence. In Hours you say why they were absent or, if they came and didn't clock in, record their clock-in and clock-out.
action.absent_other: Their shifts ended with no clock-in at all, so they count as absences. In Hours you say why they were absent or, if they came and didn't clock in, record their clock-in and clock-out.
action.late_one: Their shift has started and they haven't clocked in yet. Call them or check the schedule.
action.late_other: Their shifts have started and they haven't clocked in yet. Call them or check the schedule.
action.incomplete_one: An unclosed day can't be paid correctly. Fix it in Hours.
action.incomplete_other: An unclosed day can't be paid correctly. Fix them in Hours.
action.requests_one: Someone is waiting on you. Answer it in Inbox.
action.requests_other: People are waiting on you. Answer them in Inbox.
action.pendingSync_one: It will upload by itself once the connection is back. If it's still here tomorrow, flag it.
action.pendingSync_other: They will upload by themselves once the connection is back. If they're still here tomorrow, flag it.

kiosk.forgottenTitle: Your shift from {{day}} is still open
kiosk.forgottenBody: No clock-out was recorded that day. If you already left, use "I forgot to clock" to say when you left, or ask your manager to add it. While it stays open, the clock cannot record today's clock-in.
kiosk.pinExpiredBody: It has been a while since you entered it and, for security, that permission no longer works. Nothing was recorded yet: enter your PIN again and finish.
kiosk.stateChangedBody: It may already have been recorded. Enter your PIN again to see where things stand before repeating anything.
kiosk.photoNotice: A photo will be taken to verify your entry.
kiosk.savedOffline: Saved on this device. It will sync when the connection is back.
kiosk.pinIncorrect: That PIN isn't right. Try again — if you don't remember it, your manager can change it for you.
kiosk.pinLocked: Too many attempts. Wait {{minutes}} minutes or ask your manager for help.
kiosk.forgotBreak: I forgot to start or end a break
kiosk.forgotSubmitted: We sent your request. Your manager will review it.
kiosk.requiredBreakTookIt: I took it, I forgot to record it
kiosk.closeOpenBreakBody: Clocking out will close your break.
kiosk.exitHint: Press and hold the logo for 3 seconds.
kiosk.exitNotManager: That PIN is valid, but it doesn't belong to a manager of this location.
kiosk.exitNeedsConnection: Leaving clock mode needs a connection: the server confirms the permission.
kiosk.setupTitle: Set up this device as a time clock
kiosk.setupCodeHint: Ask an admin for it. It expires soon.
kiosk.setupCodeInvalid: That code does not work: it is mistyped, already used, or expired. Generate a new one from Settings → “Clocks (kiosks)” and type it within 30 minutes.
kiosk.setupActivated: This device is now linked to {{location}}.
kiosk.revokedBody: Ask an admin to activate it again.
kiosk.notSetUpTitle: This device is not a clock yet
kiosk.notSetUpBody: An administrator needs to set it up with an activation code before anyone can clock in here.
kiosk.offlineStateUnknown: We can't confirm your status without a connection. Wait for the network to come back.
kiosk.offlineNotReady: This device can't validate PINs offline yet. Ask for it to be synced.
kiosk.offlineNeedsReactivation: This device needs to be reactivated to validate PINs offline. It works normally with a connection.
kiosk.savedOfflinePending: Saved on this device. It will be sent on its own when the connection is back.
kiosk.requestUpdateAskManager: If you disagree, talk to your manager.
kiosk.privacyRecorded: The time of your clock-ins, clock-outs and breaks, and which store you marked them at. Your manager sees them to work out your hours.
kiosk.privacyPhoto: A photo is only taken if your store has it turned on, only at the moment you clock in, and it deletes itself after the period your company sets.
kiosk.privacyNot: The camera does not record between clock-ins, and the app does not use your location or recognise your face: your PIN identifies you.
kiosk.unavailableHereTitle: The time clock does not work in a browser
kiosk.unavailableHereBody: Clocking in needs two things a browser cannot give: storing the device credential out of reach of any extension, and a local queue that survives a page reload. A lost entry is an unpaid hour, so we would rather say so than risk it. The admin panel does work here normally.
kiosk.reasonNoteHint: One line is enough. It saves your manager from asking later.
kiosk.photoRequiredBody: In a browser the photo is the only proof that you are at the store. Allow camera access and try again.
kiosk.webNeedsNetwork: You cannot clock in from a browser while offline. Try again when you have a connection.
kiosk.departureHint: Your shift ends at {{time}}. Say it now and your manager will not have to ask tomorrow.
kiosk.departureNotePlaceholder: e.g. they called me from home

notifications.activeBody: This device will get the alerts you pick below.
notifications.deniedBody: They are turned off for this app in your system settings. You can turn them back on from there.
notifications.explainBody: We let you know about late arrivals, missing clock-outs, pending requests and clocks that stopped syncing. Alerts never include names or photos: you see those inside the app.
notifications.pendingBody: You granted permission and we are finishing the setup. If no alerts arrive, check your connection.
notifications.registerFailed: We could not register this device. We will try again next time you open the app.
notifications.unavailableKiosk: A device in clock mode does not receive notifications. Alerts go to the phone of whoever manages the store.
notifications.unavailableProject: The app notification setup is not finished yet. Let whoever manages the account know.
notifications.unavailableSession: Sign in with your account to receive alerts.
notifications.unavailableWeb: The web version does not push alerts to a phone. You still see them inside the app; to get them on a phone you need the installed app.

reports.correctionsNone: None: everything in this period was clocked without corrections.
reports.correctionsUnavailable: They couldn't be counted. Try again.
reports.correctionsFromSchedule_one: Separately, {{count}} shift recorded from the schedule.
reports.correctionsFromSchedule_other: Separately, {{count}} shifts recorded from the schedule.
reports.correctionsCredited_one: Separately, {{count}} day credited for a special reason.
reports.correctionsCredited_other: Separately, {{count}} days credited for a special reason.
reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Clocked hours for this location. It measures presence, not output: someone serving a rush and someone standing in an empty store clock the same.
reports.emptyBody: Once someone clocks in during this period, their hours, busiest days and late arrivals show up here.
reports.whoWorkedMostHint: Most to least, for the period shown. Tap someone to see just theirs.
reports.hoursAreNotOutput: These are clocked hours, not output. Two people with the same hours may have done very different work.
reports.noHours: Nobody logged completed hours in this period.
reports.howTheWeekGoesHint: Hours per day. Tap a column for its total.
reports.howTheDaysGoHint: Hours on each picked day. Tap a column for its total.
reports.howTheDaysGoWeeksHint: Hours per week, counting only the picked days. Tap a column for its total.
reports.pickDaysRangeHow: Tap the first day, then the last one.
reports.pickDaysRangeSecond: Now tap the last day. You can move to another month.
reports.pickDaysLooseHow: Tap each day to add or remove it. Tap a weekday name above to pick all of them this month.
reports.pickDaysDotLegend: The dot marks days with hours logged at this location.
reports.pickDaysTooLong: The first and last day can be at most {{count}} days apart. Remove the farthest ones.
reports.pickWeekday: Pick or remove every {{day}} this month
reports.howTheMonthGoesHint: Hours per week of the month. Tap a column to see its total.
reports.bonusRule: Earned by whoever misses no shift this month and clocks in on time for every one. Full months only.
reports.bonusProvisional: The month isn't over yet: this is provisional. A shift that hasn't come yet doesn't count.
reports.bonusProposal: It’s a proposal for whoever pays the bonus. An absence excused in Hours doesn’t cost it.
reports.bonusNobody: Nobody had published shifts this month.
reports.bonusDaysWithoutClock: Days before the store started using the clock don't count ({{days}}): those shifts couldn't be clocked.
reports.punctualitySummary_one: {{percent}}% arrived on time: {{lateText}} across {{count}} shift with a start time.
reports.punctualitySummary_other: {{percent}}% arrived on time: {{lateText}} across {{count}} shifts with a start time.
reports.punctualityNoData: No clock-in in this period had a scheduled shift, so there is nothing to measure punctuality against.
reports.nobodyLate: Nobody arrived late in this period.
reports.absencesHint: Shifts that ended with no clock-in, per person. In amber, the excused ones: they don’t cost the bonus. Review them in Hours.
reports.nobodyAbsent: Nobody was absent in this period.
reports.bonusNothingYet: None of their shifts has ended yet this month

hero.workedOnly: worked, with no published shifts to compare
hero.noPlan: There are no published shifts in this period: nothing to compare with.
hero.notStarted: No scheduled shift has started yet.
hero.soFar: At {{percent}} % of what was scheduled so far.
hero.done: {{percent}} % of what was scheduled was worked.

attendance.title: Attendance by person
attendance.hint: What each person was scheduled and worked, with their late arrivals and absences. Tap someone to see only theirs.
attendance.empty: Nobody had a shift or clocked in during this period.

incidents.title: Absences, late arrivals and early departures
incidents.hint: Everything that happened in the period and how it ended. What you fix in Hours still counts here: it stops being pending, it does not disappear. Tap someone to see only theirs.
incidents.empty: No absences, late arrivals or early departures in the period.
incidents.lateLine: Arrived {{time}} late: clocked in at {{in}}, and the shift started at {{start}}
incidents.earlyLine: Left {{time}} early: at {{out}}, and the shift ended at {{end}}
incidents.creditedLine: Did not come in and the shift was credited: {{time}} counted

reports.unscheduledExcluded_one: {{count}} clock-in with no scheduled shift is left out: there was no time to be late for.
reports.unscheduledExcluded_other: {{count}} clock-ins with no scheduled shift are left out: there was no time to be late for.
reports.overtimeHint: Overtime approved in Hours, totalled per person. A few minutes early or late are not overtime: only what a manager approves.
reports.overtimeIsInformational: This is a time summary, not a payroll calculation: premiums and local law are applied by whoever pays.
reports.noOvertime: No approved overtime in this period. It is approved in Hours, on each person's day.
reports.whereTimeGoesHint: {{total}} of breaks in this period, by reason.
reports.noBreaksBody: Once someone takes a break with a reason, this shows where the time goes.
reports.personPicked: Showing only {{name}}. The three charts below are about this person.
reports.shareWhat_one: You're about to share the hours of {{count}} person, for {{period}}.
reports.shareWhat_other: You're about to share the hours of {{count}} people, for {{period}}.
reports.shareCsvHint: To open in Excel. Includes the per-person detail: hours, overtime, late arrivals and breaks.
reports.shareSummaryHint: To paste into a chat. Location totals only; no names except whoever tops the list.
reports.shareFailedBody: Try again. If it keeps failing, export from Hours instead.
reports.shareFootnote: These are real people's hours. Check where you're sending it before you do.
reports.summaryFooter: These are clocked hours, not output.
reports.punctualityNoDataShort: Punctuality: no scheduled shifts to measure it against

requests.title: Inbox
requests.approveSheetBody: Approving records the punch under your name, with the request's reason, and it shows in Hours right away. Confirm the day and time.
requests.clockOutOptional: Clock-out time (if that was missed too)
requests.clockOutOptionalHint: Someone who missed clocking in couldn't clock out either. If they already left, enter it: without a clock-out the shift stays open.
requests.approvedRegistered: Approved. The punch was recorded and shows in Hours.
requests.impactRegisters: Approving asks you to confirm the day and time, then records the punch in Hours.
requests.approveErrorAlreadyIn: They were already clocked in at that time: another clock-in doesn't fit. Check the day in Hours.
requests.approveErrorNotIn: They were off shift at that time: there has to be a clock-in first.
requests.approveErrorAlreadyOnBreak: They were already on break at that time. If only the end was missed, choose “Only the end”.
requests.approveErrorNotOnBreak: They weren't on break at that time. If the whole break was missed, choose “The whole break”.
requests.approveErrorNoFit: That punch doesn't fit at that time. Check the day in Hours.
requests.approveErrorClash: Those punches clash with others they did record that day. Check the day in Hours.
requests.approveErrorNeedsClockOut: That shift has no clock-out: enter the time they left too.
requests.approveErrorAlreadyReviewed: Someone else already resolved this request.
requests.approveErrorFuture: That time hasn't happened yet: a missed punch is always in the past.
requests.approveErrorOrder: The end is before the start: check the times.
requests.reviewErrorGeneric: The decision couldn't be saved. Try again.
requests.approvedApplied: Approved and applied to the timesheet.
requests.approvedNotApplied: Approved. The hours still need to be corrected by hand.
requests.impactApplies: Approving corrects the session and leaves an audit trail.
requests.impactManual: This request does not point at hours on a session: after approving, the hours need to be corrected by hand.
requests.noRequestsHint: When someone asks for a correction, it shows up here.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.notesSaved: Note saved. The shift stays published: nothing to publish.
schedule.notesHelp: The note for the employee shows on their phone and on the clock; the private note, only to managers. Changing only the notes of a published shift doesn’t need publishing.
schedule.overlapWarning: {{name}} has two overlapping shifts on {{day}}: {{first}} and {{second}}.
schedule.shortRestWarning: {{name}} leaves on {{fromDay}} at {{fromTime}} and starts again on {{toDay}} at {{toTime}}: {{hours}} of rest, and the minimum is {{minimum}}.
schedule.weeklyLimitWarning: {{name}} has {{hours}} scheduled this week and the limit is {{limit}}.
schedule.totalWeeklyDrafts: {{drafts}} in draft and {{published}} published. Home and Reports count only what's published.
schedule.retroactiveWarning: You're changing a past week. We record who did it and when.
schedule.cancelShiftHint: A published shift is not deleted: it is cancelled and stays in the history.
schedule.copyPreviousWeekHint: Last week's shifts are copied as drafts, without repeating the ones already in this week. Nothing is published until you decide.
schedule.copyScopeAll: The whole week will be copied.
schedule.copyScopeOne: Only that person's shifts will be copied.
schedule.discardDraftsBody_one: This week's draft shift that was never published is deleted. Published shifts and rest days are not touched.
schedule.discardDraftsBody_other: This week's {{count}} draft shifts that were never published are deleted. Published shifts and rest days are not touched.
schedule.discardDraftsKeepsChanged_one: {{count}} change to an already published shift stays: publish it or edit it in its shift.
schedule.discardDraftsKeepsChanged_other: {{count}} changes to already published shifts stay: publish them or edit them in their shifts.
schedule.draftsDiscardFailed: Not every draft could be discarded. The grid shows the ones left: try again.
schedule.pasteOverlapsExisting: {{names}} already has shifts at those times: pasting them again would duplicate them. If you already pasted this week and want to start over, close this and tap “Discard drafts”.

worked.noticeBody_one: {{count}} published shift has no punches. If it was worked, record it in one go.
worked.noticeBody_other: {{count}} published shifts have no punches. If they were worked, record them in one go.
worked.title: Record as worked
worked.intro: For the days before the clock was in use. For each published shift, a clock-in, the meal break and a clock-out are created at its exact times, as if it had been worked. In Hours they show as “From schedule”, so it is clear nobody punched them.
worked.none: There are no shifts to record this week.
worked.skippedMarks_one: {{count}} shift already has punches: it is left alone.
worked.skippedMarks_other: {{count}} shifts already have punches: they are left alone.
worked.skippedDraft_one: {{count}} shift is a draft: publish it first.
worked.skippedDraft_other: {{count}} shifts are drafts: publish them first.
worked.skippedClock_one: {{count}} shift is on or after {{day}}, when the clock was already in use: fix it in Hours.
worked.skippedClock_other: {{count}} shifts are on or after {{day}}, when the clock was already in use: fix them in Hours.
worked.skippedOpen_one: {{count}} shift overlaps an open work session: check it in Hours.
worked.skippedOpen_other: {{count}} shifts overlap an open work session: check them in Hours.
worked.failed: Could not record. Try again: anything already recorded is not duplicated.

schedule.pasteHint: Paste the schedule table as you already have it: one row per person, one column per day, {{from}} to {{to}}. You see what was understood before anything is created.
schedule.pasteExample:
Ana – FT | OFF | 10:00–19:00 | 11:00–20:00 | 48h

Separate columns with a tab, two spaces or «|» — a table copied from a spreadsheet already arrives that way. «OFF» (or DESCANSO, LIBRE, X) marks a day off and shows on the grid; a dash or an empty cell create nothing, which is what you need for someone who no longer works that week. A trailing hours column is used as a check.
schedule.pasted_one: {{count}} shift created as a draft. Review it and press “Publish schedule”.
schedule.pasted_other: {{count}} shifts created as drafts. Review them and press “Publish schedule”.
schedule.pasteBreakRule: Shifts of 8 h or more carry a 1 h unpaid meal break; shorter ones carry none. Each shift can be adjusted afterwards.
schedule.pasteAlreadyHasShifts_one: This week already has {{count}} shift. Pasting adds shifts, it does not replace the ones already there.
schedule.pasteAlreadyHasShifts_other: This week already has {{count}} shifts. Pasting adds shifts, it does not replace the ones already there.
schedule.pasteNothingRead: There is no row with hours in what you pasted.
schedule.pasteUnknownName: “{{name}}” is not on this location's team. Add them in Team, or fix the name in the table.
schedule.pasteAmbiguousName: “{{name}}” could be {{options}}. Write the full name in the table.
schedule.pasteBadCell: “{{text}}” was not understood ({{name}}, {{day}}). Write it as 10:00–19:00, or OFF for a day off.
schedule.pasteWrongWeek: That table is from another week: its header says days {{header}} and this week is {{days}}. Switch weeks or fix the table.
schedule.pasteOverlap: {{name}} has two overlapping shifts inside the same table.
schedule.pasteTotalMismatch: {{name}}: {{read}} was read and your table says {{declared}}. Check that row before creating.
schedule.pasteSamePersonTwice: {{name}} appears in two rows of the table: {{rows}}. Keep one row per person, or write the full name if they are different people.
schedule.pasteTooLong: {{name}}, {{day}}: “{{text}}” would be {{hours}} in a row, and no shift goes past 16 h. Check the start or the end time.
schedule.pasteLongNight: {{name}}, {{day}}: “{{text}}” runs past midnight and lasts {{hours}}. If that is right you can create it; if not, check the end time.
schedule.pasteRestReplaced_one: {{count}} day off already marked on a day where the table puts a shift will be removed: {{list}}.
schedule.pasteRestReplaced_other: {{count}} days off already marked on days where the table puts a shift will be removed: {{list}}.
schedule.pasteRestOnShift: The table puts a day off on days that already have a shift: {{list}}. Delete that shift first, or remove the day off from the table.
schedule.crossesMidnightHint: The shift ends the next day.
schedule.deleteShiftHint: It is a draft: deleting it does not affect the published schedule.
schedule.editShiftHint: Tap to edit, duplicate or delete this shift
schedule.invalidBreak: Write the break in minutes (60, 45 min) or hours (1:00, 1 h), shorter than the shift.
schedule.shiftTooLong: This shift would last {{hours}} and none goes past 16 h. Check the start or end time.
schedule.invalidTime: Enter the time as HH:mm, for example 09:30.
schedule.noPublicationsYet: This week has not been published yet.
schedule.publishAllConfirm_one: {{count}} change will be published. Your team sees it after entering their PIN.
schedule.publishAllConfirm_other: {{count}} changes will be published. Your team sees them after entering their PIN.
schedule.publishPickerHint: Choose which changes to publish. The ones you leave unchecked stay as drafts.
schedule.retroactiveReadOnly: Only an administrator can correct a past week.
schedule.retroactiveTitle: You are in a past week
schedule.saveDraftHint: Saved without publishing. To let the team see it, publish from the schedule.

unusual.body: They clocked in fine, but an hour or more outside the shift. It may be a schedule change or overtime: you decide.
unusual.earlyNoAmount: Clocked in well before the shift
unusual.lateNoAmount: Clocked out well after the shift

schedule.markRestDayHint: It is marked as a day off. It counts no hours and does not show on the kiosk.
schedule.restDayExplainer: A day off has no hours and no job role: it only says that person rests that day. Tap it on the grid to remove it.
schedule.removeRestDayHint: The day is left unmarked: neither a day off nor a shift.
schedule.copiedSkipped_one: {{count}} shift was not copied because that person already had a shift or a day off then.
schedule.copiedSkipped_other: {{count}} shifts were not copied because those people already had a shift or a day off then.
schedule.pasteRestAlso_one: {{count}} day off will also be marked.
schedule.pasteRestAlso_other: {{count}} days off will also be marked.

scope.title: Where you're working
scope.openHint: Opens the list of companies and locations, and the form to add a new one.
scope.createHint: A company is a different business, with its own people and its own hours. A location is another store of the same business.

settings.managerNeedsLocation: A manager needs at least one location.
settings.addJobRoleDone: Job role "{{name}}" is open. You can assign it when adding someone.
settings.addJobRoleName: Name of the new job role
settings.addLocationDone: Location {{name}} is open. Pick it above to configure it.
settings.addLocationHint: It is created with the default settings and the company time zone. You can fine-tune all of it right here afterwards.
settings.addOrganizationDoneBody: It now shows in the company picker above. You are still in the one you had open.
settings.addOrganizationHint: For a different business, not another store of the same one: each company has its own people, shifts and hours, and they never mix. If you are opening one more store, use "Open a new location" below.
settings.allowUnscheduledHint: Lets people clock in without a scheduled shift.
settings.appLanguageHint: Changes this app's language on this device.
settings.appThemeHint: Changes this app's look on this device. “Automatic” follows the system.
settings.brandColorHint: Pick one of the suggestions or type your own. The app adjusts it just enough that everything painted on top stays readable, and keeps your hue.
settings.brandGreyBody: It works, but your color will barely show. If your brand is grey, that's fine; if you mistyped the code, check it.
settings.brandHint: Your business's logo and color. They show up mainly on the shop's time clock, the screen your team looks at every day.
settings.brandNearStatusBody: In this app green, amber and red mean working, on break and late. Your color sits {{distancia}} away and the minimum to tell them apart is 8, so your team could confuse them. You can still use it: statuses always carry an icon and a word too.
settings.brandPreview: This is how the shop's clock will look
settings.brandPreviewA11y: Preview of the shop's time clock with the chosen color.
settings.codeFailed: We could not generate the code. Try again.

manual.title: How to use Krealo Shift
manual.subtitle: A short guide. How to clock in and out, and what to do when something does not go as expected.
manual.workerWhereBody: On the store's device: the screen with the big clock and the number keypad. It is always the same one. You cannot clock from your own phone, but you can see your schedule and use “My availability” to say which days you can't work or leave a comment: whoever builds the schedule sees it. If you had a shift and didn't clock in at all during it, it counts as an absence and you'll see it on your phone; if you came and didn't clock in, tell your manager.
manual.mark1When: When you arrive and your shift starts.
manual.mark2When: When you leave for your meal break.
manual.mark3When: When you come back from your break.
manual.marksWhyBody: If you only clock in and out, your day comes out as nine hours instead of eight: the meal hour is deducted only if you mark it.
manual.howTitle: How to clock, step by step
manual.how1: Type your PIN. It is submitted as soon as you complete the last digit: there is no OK button.
manual.how2: Your name and today's shift appear.
manual.how3: Tap the button you need. The clock only offers what makes sense: if you already clocked in, it will not offer it again.
manual.how4: You get three seconds to cancel. If you do not, it is recorded with that moment's time.
manual.how5: The screen confirms the time and goes back to the clock by itself. Your name disappears for whoever comes next.
manual.casesTitle: If something does not go as expected
manual.casePinBody: Try again. After several tries in a row it locks for a few minutes: nothing is broken, it is so nobody can guess your PIN by trying.
manual.caseEarlyBody: Clock in when you arrive, even before your time: the clock won't stop you. If you arrive much earlier (an hour or more), whoever runs the store sees it and decides whether it's a schedule change or extra time.
manual.caseLateBody: Clock in anyway, always. There are a few minutes of grace — five, unless your store changed it — and after that it is recorded as late, with your real time. Not clocking is worse: that day looks like you never came.
manual.caseForgotBody: Use “I forgot to clock” on the clock and propose the time. It goes to whoever runs the store to approve: nobody changes hours on their own.
manual.caseRestTitle: It was my day off and I came to cover
manual.caseRestBody: Clock in anyway. The clock will say “Work without a scheduled shift” and those hours count like any other.
manual.caseEarlyOutTitle: I am leaving before my time
manual.caseEarlyOutBody: When you clock out it will ask you why. Pick the one that fits: that is what keeps it from looking like you left without telling anyone.
manual.caseOfflineTitle: There is no internet at the store
manual.caseOfflineBody: The clock cannot record and tells you on screen instead of storing it. Let someone know and try again when there is signal: that way you are never left wondering whether it registered.
manual.breakReasonsBody: When you start a break you pick why: meal, short break, personal permission, meeting, training, a store errand, or other. Pick the real one: your hours depend on it, and so does whether it looks like lost time.
manual.pinBody: Do not share it and do not clock for someone else: that is a problem for both of you. If you forget it, whoever runs the store resets it in a minute.
manual.adminScheduleBody: The week's shifts. “Paste schedule” enters the whole table at once, and “Copy previous week” repeats last week. Days off are marked and show on the grid. Add a shift with the “+” in its empty slot, and a second shift on the same day with “Duplicate shift” in the shift sheet. The thin line on each shift shows which part of the day it covers, so you can see who opens and who closes. At the top you'll also see clock-ins outside the shift (anyone who came in an hour or more early or left an hour or more late): tap “Review” to change their shift, approve the overtime in Hours or mark it as seen.
manual.adminPublishTitle: Publishing is what makes it real
manual.adminPublishBody: A draft shift does NOT exist for the clock: whoever clocks will see “You have no scheduled shift”. Press “Publish schedule” once the week is ready. Changing the person, day or hours of a published shift turns it back into a draft until you publish; changing only its notes doesn’t: they’re saved and the shift stays published.
manual.adminTeamBody: This is where each person is added and PINs are reset. The app generates the PIN: nobody picks it, and whoever runs the store sees it once to hand it over. Each row shows their week day by day, with the total; open their card to see when they clocked in and out each day and how much they worked each week of the month. “Availability”, inside Team, shows what each person said about their days (days they can't work, hours they prefer, their comments), with new ones flagged so you can mark them as seen. It also shows on the Schedule, and a shift that clashes with a “can't work” is flagged in red. On their card, “Phone” says whether the person has signed in on their phone with their email: until they do, they can’t see their schedule or set their availability. When someone leaves, “Left the company” asks for their last day: everything before it is kept (hours, absences, reports, bonus) and their later shifts are removed from the schedule.
manual.adminHoursBody: What was clocked, day by day, with totals. At the top, “Cases to resolve” gathers what needs your decision: someone who left before their time (“Owes” or “It’s justified”), someone who didn’t clock their meal break (“Deduct the break” or “Worked through the break”) and someone still in after their shift (“Clock out”). Below, the week’s absences: a published shift that ended with no clock-in at all counts as an absence once your store uses the clock, and it shows the same in Schedule, Team, Reports, the bonus and the person’s phone. If they really were absent, “Why were they absent?” lets you say whether it’s excused and why (sick leave, family emergency, notified leave, no notice, late notice or other, with a comment): it shows on all those screens, and an excused absence doesn’t cost the bonus. If they came and didn’t clock in, “Came, didn’t clock in” records their clock-in and clock-out with your reason, and the absence goes away everywhere. Hours someone owes stay on their Team profile, where you mark them made up or forgive them, and the person sees them on their phone. “Add manual entry” records what is missing, with a required reason, audited under your name and not as if the person had clocked it.
manual.adminInboxBody: “I forgot to clock” requests wait for your yes or no. Approving asks you to confirm the day and time, and the punch is recorded in Hours. Until you resolve them, those hours do not count.
manual.adminKioskBody: Settings → “Clocks (kiosks)” → “Generate activation code”. Six digits, good for thirty minutes and for a single use. On the store's device, open the clock address and type the code; naming the device is optional. NOTE: the code is generated for the location selected at the top, so check it is the right one before generating it, and that the device's screen confirms that same location when it activates.
manual.adminKioskNote: The device stays in the store: the pairing lives in that browser. Do not clear the browser's data or use private mode, and activate it from the same place where it will be used.
manual.adminBreakTitle: The meal break, the one most often forgotten
manual.adminBreakBody: The meal hour lives on the shift and is what makes a nine-hour day count as eight. But it is deducted only if the person marks the start and the end of their break. Tell your team it is four taps, not two.
manual.footer: This page can be shared: it asks for no user and no password.
